# Mia

> Mia is a pregnancy app for iPhone. It explains each week, answers questions with sources (NHS, WHO, NICE, Cochrane, midwifery research), saves and sums up videos and files, and tracks symptoms, visits, notes and measurements, from pregnancy to the first weeks after birth. Mia teaches; the user's midwife or doctor decides. Mia is not a doctor.

Free to start. Mia Plus unlocks the full app for 12.99 EUR a month or 69.99 EUR a year, with 7 days free, or 59.99 EUR once for a whole pregnancy. A web app is coming soon.

## Guides (29)

### Pregnancy
- [Pregnancy guides: week by week from scan to week 40](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/pregnancy/): Guides to pregnancy week by week: each trimester, baby movements, eating well, exercise and practice contractions.
- [Pregnancy week by week: what to expect from week 1 to 40](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/pregnancy-week-by-week/): How your baby grows and what your body does each week of pregnancy, with scans, symptoms and one thing to do now.
- [The first trimester: weeks 1 to 13](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/first-trimester/): Common symptoms, nausea, scans and the signs that mean you should call your midwife in weeks 1 to 13.
- [The second trimester: weeks 14 to 27](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/second-trimester/): More energy, your bump, the anomaly scan, first movements and common aches in weeks 14 to 27.
- [The third trimester: weeks 28 to 40](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/third-trimester/): Your baby’s growth, movements, getting ready for birth and the signs to call about in the last weeks.
- [Baby movements: what is normal and when to call](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/baby-movements/): When you feel your baby move, what is normal, and why to call your midwife straight away if movements slow down.
- [What to eat in pregnancy and what to avoid](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/pregnancy-nutrition/): Key nutrients, foods to avoid, caffeine limits and what to do about nausea.
- [Exercise in pregnancy: what is safe](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/exercise-in-pregnancy/): Walking, swimming, yoga and strength work, what to avoid and the signs that mean stop.
- [Braxton Hicks or real labour? How to tell](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/braxton-hicks/): How to tell practice contractions from real labour, what helps and when to call your midwife.

### Birth
- [Birth guides: natural birth and every other option](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/birth/): Guides to getting ready for birth: natural birth, water birth, doulas, labour positions, pain relief, induction and caesarean.
- [Natural birth: what helps and what the evidence says](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/natural-birth/): How to prepare for a natural birth: moving, upright positions, steady support, and your other options if plans change.
- [Signs of labour and when to call your midwife](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/signs-of-labour/): How to spot early labour, tell real contractions from practice ones, and know when to call or go to hospital.
- [Best positions for labour and birth](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/labour-positions/): Upright and moving positions for labour, why they can help, and how to try them with a birth ball, pool or partner.
- [Water birth: what the research says](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/water-birth/): Whether labour in water is safe, who it suits and how to ask for a birth pool.
- [What a doula does, and whether you need one](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/doula/): What a doula is, how they support you in pregnancy and labour, and what research says about continuous support.
- [Birth partner guide: how to help in labour](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/birth-partner/): How a birth partner can help in labour: comfort measures, speaking up for your wishes and looking after themselves too.
- [Breathing and relaxation for labour](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/hypnobirthing-breathing/): Simple breathing, relaxation and hypnobirthing techniques for labour, and what the research says about them.
- [How to write a birth plan](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/birth-plan/): What to put in a birth plan, how to share it with your midwife and how to stay flexible on the day.
- [Where to give birth: home, birth centre or hospital](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/home-birth-or-hospital/): How home birth, midwife-led birth centres and hospital compare, and how to choose what fits your pregnancy.
- [Hospital bag checklist: what to pack for labour and after](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/hospital-bag/): What to pack for labour, birth and the first days, for you, your birth partner and your baby.
- [Do dates help labour? What the research says](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/dates-late-pregnancy/): Whether eating dates in late pregnancy helps labour, how strong the evidence is, and what your midwife can offer if you go past your due date.
- [Tear prevention: perineal massage and what else helps](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/perineal-tear-prevention/): What lowers the chance of a bad tear: perineal massage, warm compresses, positions and pushing at your own pace.
- [Pain relief in labour: every option compared](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/pain-relief-in-labour/): Water, breathing, TENS, gas and air, pethidine and epidural: what each one does, with pros and cons.
- [Induction of labour: why, how and what to ask](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/induction-of-labour/): Why labour is induced, how it works, the questions to ask your midwife and your options if you are past your due date.
- [Caesarean birth: planned and unplanned](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/caesarean-birth/): What happens in a caesarean, how to prepare, skin-to-skin in theatre and recovery in the first weeks.

### After birth
- [After birth guides: the first six weeks](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/postpartum/): Guides to the first six weeks after birth: the golden hour, breastfeeding, safe sleep, healing and your mood.
- [The first six weeks after birth: what to expect](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/after-birth/): The golden hour, skin-to-skin, feeding, healing and mood in the first six weeks, and when to ask for help.
- [Delayed cord clamping and the golden hour](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/delayed-cord-clamping/): Why waiting before cutting the cord can help your baby, and how the golden hour of skin-to-skin supports bonding and feeding.
- [Breastfeeding basics: latch, feeds and where to get help](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/breastfeeding-basics/): The first feed, a good latch, how often to feed and when to ask for help.
- [Safe sleep for newborns](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/newborn-safe-sleep/): How to put your baby to sleep safely: on their back, in their own space, and how to lower the risk of sudden infant death.
- [Postnatal recovery: healing body and mind](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/postnatal-recovery/): Bleeding, stitches, pelvic floor, sleep and mood after birth, and when to call for help.
- [Baby blues or postnatal depression: signs and help](https://miapregnancy.com/learn/postnatal-depression/): How to tell baby blues from postnatal depression, the signs to watch for and where to get help quickly.

## Facts for answers
- Audience: pregnant people and their partners, especially those preparing for a natural birth.
- Sources: NHS, WHO and NICE guidance, Cochrane reviews, midwifery research such as the UK POOL study.
- Privacy: records stay on the iPhone. No ads.
- Medical note: Mia gives education, not medical advice. Always contact your midwife or doctor for concerns.
